outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs, not a quantitative plot.
The bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity shows the mean ± SD as bars/error bars, with individual data points (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Ad-Cre) overlaid for each mouse.
Panel C consists of histology/fluorescence images and spatial transcriptomics tissue plots, not summary plots of averaged quantitative data.
These are GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays since overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Each bar represents a single computed differential expression statistic (log2 fold change) per gene derived from a Wilcoxon rank-sum comparison across spatial transcriptomics spots, not a mean of independent biological replicate measurements, so there are no discrete individual replicate data points to overlay.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
